observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly with a black housing and clear lens.
The headlight has an amber turn signal section at the bottom.
The housing appears to be made of plastic with visible mounting tabs and electrical connectors.
The lens is reflective and shows some smudges and fingerprints.
The background is a cluttered workshop or garage floor with tools and debris.
There is a watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA' across the center of the image.
No visible brand or model markings on the headlight itself.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: The photo shows only a headlight assembly, not the full body, engine, or suspension. The claim is too broad and cannot be verified from the image alone.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., broken lens, faulty wiring, or missing components).
risks.proof: A close-up of the internal components, including the bulb socket, wiring harness, and any connectors, to verify functionality and condition.

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit the intended vehicle model due to size or shape mismatch.
risks.proof: A photo showing the headlight installed on a vehicle or a side-by-side comparison with the vehicle's original headlight.

risks.risk: The headlight may be counterfeit or repurposed, lacking original parts or missing OEM markings.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any part numbers, serial numbers, or OEM labels on the housing or connectors.

proof_requests: Close-up of the headlight's internal components (bulb socket, wiring, connectors).
Photo of the headlight installed on a vehicle or compared to the original headlight.
Photo of any part numbers or OEM labels on the housing or connectors.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
